product_metadata.title: yosager Tower Fan, 28 Inch 60° Oscillating Cooling Fan Powerful Floor Fan, 3 Speeds, Stand up Tower Fan, Standing Fans Space Saving Slim Design for Home Bedroom Office
features: Easily Customize Cooling Needs: Our multiple functional oscillating tower fan is designed with 3 fan speeds - Low / Med / High. So you can customize your airflow and cooling needs easily in the sweltering summer.

60° Wide Angle Oscillation: This stand up fan equips with a wide 60° Oscillation and 3 wind speed. Combined with air conditioning, our wide angle oscillations and long wind curves oscillating tower fan effectively distribute adequate air circulation to make cool air flow fill your room faster.
Ultra-quiet Cooling Fan: The ultra-quiet motor operation as low as 48dB and smoothing oscillation ensuring a peaceful environment in any room. Gives you a cool and undisturbed sleep environment.

Space Saving: Space-saving slim design, takes up less room than stand fans and is ideal for use in living areas where floor space is limited. it can easily work in a tight corner. Ideal fans for use in bedrooms, office cubicles, or dorm rooms.

Quite Safe for Family: A bladeless tower fan design is much safer for families with children or pets, narrow fence to keep the children's fingers out, dogs and cats can not insert their paws or noses. The weighted base allows our floor fan to stabilize. When children or pets unintentionally bump into it, the special design prevents it from wobbling or falling easily.
